summary: Keep shared checkpoint weight allocations compatible with CUDA IPC
models: Models loaded through the native B12X shared GDS reader
compatibility: Shared GDS loading temporarily disables expandable segments for weight allocation and restores the complete runtime allocator configuration afterward. CuMem and sleep-mode allocations are rejected because their virtual-memory backing cannot use the reader's CUDA IPC export path.
details: Checkpoint loading preserves unrelated allocator settings and restores the original configuration after successful loading or an exception. Bounce loading retains its allocator behavior.
